card.name: Words just before make/produce verbs
card.fires_on: Small words (are, was, to, you) or a subject noun right after something being made, where the next word is likely make, produce, create or form. Seen in general web text about cells, proteins, money, fuel.

modes.label: Passive before made/produced
modes.description: Words like are or was after a thing that is being made, expecting made, produced or formed.

modes.label: To before make/generate
modes.description: The word to after a material or source, leading into a purpose verb like make, heat or generate.

modes.label: Subject before makes/produces
modes.description: A noun or pronoun subject right before a verb of making.
modes.example: a hormone the<< body>> produces naturally?

card.writes: It raises create-type verbs and lowers insert-type words, steering the next word toward making or creating.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a verb like make, produce or create is expected.
